## Main difference

The two logs are almost the same run from a protocol perspective; the big difference is that they are just different random executions of the same consensus flow.

  - 4 replicas, 1 client

  - replica 3 proposes in view 2
  - replica 4 proposes in view 3
  - replica 1 proposes in view 4
